body.statement: A finite existential formula consisting of polynomial equalities and weak or strict polynomial inequalities with rational or represented real-algebraic coefficients is decidable by exact real-algebraic sign decomposition.  Real-algebraic inputs can be represented by defining integer polynomials and rational isolating intervals, and the output is certified by exact sign evaluations on the resulting cells.

source.locator: Basu, Pollack, and Roy (2006), Chapters 2 and 14
